Heat in Manila

Manila

A dense, humid metropolis where heat can close schools.

What heat does here

5,288

schools in the Philippines moved to remote learning in April 2024, affecting more than 3.6 million students.

What is in place

A city team for heat

Quezon City has a Heat Action Team, chief heat action officers, and 32 libraries opened as cooling centres.

What helps

Cooler classrooms keep children learning through the hot season.
